uat_items.requirement: FR-1: Non-Destructive Legacy Source Isolation & Untouched charting.py
uat_items.description: Verify that legacy repositories (AlphaInsight and 4leafclover) have zero modified files and that copied charting.py in Alpha_Insight matches the source file byte-for-byte (SHA-256 hash equality).

uat_items.requirement: FR-5: Database Continuity & Alembic Version Control
uat_items.description: Verify that SQLAlchemy models map all 13 existing 4leafclover tables plus user_sessions and job_execution_log, and that Alembic migrations 0001 and 0002 compile and upgrade cleanly.

uat_items.requirement: FR-2: Monolithic FastAPI Auth, Sessions, Watchlist, Portfolio & Transactions API
uat_items.description: Verify FastAPI endpoints for Google OAuth / mock login, PostgreSQL session persistence, watchlist data retrieval, portfolio dashboard aggregation, transaction CRUD, and AI analysis.
Verify that chart_runner.py invokes untouched charting.py using an OS-agnostic temporary directory and returns a valid base64 PNG image.

uat_items.requirement: FR-6: Standalone Cloud Run Job Pipeline (main.py)
uat_items.description: Verify that main.py runs the daily pipeline steps, records execution status in job_execution_log, and uses externalized configuration with no hardcoded magic numbers.

uat_items.requirement: FR-3: Centralized Design System & Zero Hardcoding Audit
uat_items.description: Verify that all Design System primitives render properly and that zero feature components in frontend/src/components/ contain hardcoded hex colors (e.g., #[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}) or hardcoded localhost URLs.

uat_items.requirement: FR-3 & FR-4 (Frontend): Dual Chart Comparison Switcher & Mobile/Desktop Ergonomics
uat_items.description: Verify ChartComparisonView 3-way switcher (Matplotlib PNG, Interactive Canvas, Split Compare), touch-enabled zoom slider, mobile accordion cards, and responsive layouts.
